result.summary: Extends the `-walletbroadcast` configuration option to accept `initialonly` alongside boolean `0` and `1`. Setting `-walletbroadcast=initialonly` allows the wallet to perform initial transaction submission and network broadcast while disabling periodic rebroadcasts and startup mempool resubmission. The default setting remains unchanged at `1` (initial broadcast and periodic rebroadcast).
result.problem: Periodic wallet rebroadcasts resend unconfirmed transactions to peers every 12–36 hours and resubmit them on startup, which leaks wallet transaction ownership to the network. Users had no way to turn off these periodic rebroadcasts without disabling wallet transaction broadcasting entirely.
evidence: PR description: "Add a new possible value initialonly which would allow the user to configure the wallet to do the initial broadcast only and not to do the periodic rebroadcasts. No new configuration options and no change in default behavior."
result.scope_notes: A compact wallet-only change replacing the internal boolean `fBroadcastTransactions` with a three-state `BroadcastWhen` enum.
result.changed_since_previous: Replaced the previous approach of introducing a separate `-walletrebroadcast` option (which defaulted to false) with extending the existing `-walletbroadcast` parameter to accept `initialonly`, keeping default behavior unchanged.
result.card: Extends the `-walletbroadcast` configuration option to accept `initialonly` alongside boolean values `0` and `1`. Currently, users cannot disable periodic unconfirmed transaction rebroadcasts (which leak wallet ownership to peers every 12–36 hours) without turning off transaction broadcasting completely. The new value allows initial broadcasts while skipping periodic resends and startup mempool resubmissions, preserving the existing default behavior.

risk.why: A mistake in parsing or checking the broadcast mode could inadvertently suppress transaction broadcast or fail to disable periodic rebroadcasts.
